capabilities: Format notes from a toolbar, selection bubble, and slash commands
Move and transform blocks with margin drag handles
Copy and paste cleanly between Obsidian and other apps via the HTML clipboard
Attach PDFs and images so files are stored in the note's own folder
Dictate text and rewrite selections with AI actions
extras: Discloses what the community-catalog scan reports (vault enumeration and clipboard access), states there is no telemetry, and notes the bundled @anthropic-ai/sdk is the only network code besides dictation.
problem: Formatting in Obsidian means writing Markdown syntax by hand, pasting to email or from Word mangles formatting, and attached files land in a shared folder instead of staying with their note.

relations.evidence: Power Tables takes over from here if you want sorting, filters, colors, and totals.
Uses your own Anthropic key. The default model costs pennies.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible transcription service or local Whisper server for dictation

summary: Adds a Word-style formatting toolbar, selection bubble, slash commands, block drag handles, clean cross-app paste, dictation, and AI edits while notes stay plain Markdown.
